這篇英文作文已經掌握了基本內容和時序，但在文法、拼字與句構上有一些錯誤與可以改進之處。下面是逐句的修改建議與一個較好的版本範文：

---

### 原文（含錯誤處標記）：

> The day before **the exam**, Amber played video game too late, so she didn’t prepare her exam.  
> Then on the day of the exam, she was very tired, even slept during the exam.  
> Finally, she didn’t finish her exam. She was very worried and **regret** about it.  
> She **swear** that she **never do** again.

---

### 錯誤說明與修改建議：

1. **"video game" → "video games"**  
   玩的是一種活動，應該用複數。

2. **"too late" → "very late" 或 "until very late"**  
   "too late" 比較偏向「太遲」，這裡要表達的是她玩得很晚。

3. **"prepare her exam" → "prepare for her exam"**  
   "prepare for" 才是正確搭配。

4. **"even slept during the exam" → "and even slept during the exam"**  
   加上 "and" 讓語句更通順。

5. **"regret about it" → "regretted it"**  
   "regret" 是動詞，後面不加 "about"；時態也應該是過去式。

6. **"She swear" → "She swore"**  
   "swear" 的過去式是 "swore"。

7. **"she never do again" → "she would never do it again"**  
   時態與語氣要配合 "swore"（過去式），使用 "would" 表示誓言的內容。

---

### 修改後的完整範文（約 70 字）：

**The day before the exam, Amber played video games until very late, so she didn’t prepare for her exam. On the exam day, she was very tired and even slept during the test. In the end, she didn’t finish it. She was very worried and regretted it. She swore that she would never do it again.**

---

如果想讓句子再自然一點，也可以考慮這種進階版本：

**Amber played video games late into the night before her exam, so she didn’t prepare at all. The next day, she was so tired that she even fell asleep during the test. She didn’t finish it and felt terrible afterward. She promised herself she would never make the same mistake again.**
